WITH quarantined AS (
    UPDATE automation.approval_reminders
    SET status = 'delivery_unknown',
        last_error = 'Approval reminder worker lease expired',
        lease_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL
    WHERE status = 'processing'
      AND lease_expires_at <= NOW()
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT COUNT(*)::integer AS quarantined_count
FROM quarantined;

WITH selected AS (
    SELECT r.id
    FROM automation.approval_reminders AS r
    JOIN public.approval_requests AS a
      ON a.id = r.approval_id
     AND a.organization_id = r.organization_id
     AND a.incident_id = r.incident_id
    WHERE r.status = 'pending'
      AND r.attempts < 5
      AND a.status = 'pending'
    ORDER BY r.created_at, r.id
    FOR UPDATE OF r SKIP LOCKED
    LIMIT 10
),
claimed AS (
    UPDATE automation.approval_reminders AS r
    SET
        status = 'processing',
        attempts = r.attempts + 1,
        lease_token = gen_random_uuid(),
        lease_expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
    FROM selected
    WHERE r.id = selected.id
    RETURNING
        r.id AS reminder_id,
        r.approval_id,
        r.organization_id,
        r.incident_id,
        r.reminder_level,
        r.lease_token
)
SELECT * FROM claimed;

SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM automation.approval_reminders AS r
    JOIN public.approval_requests AS a
      ON a.id = r.approval_id
     AND a.organization_id = r.organization_id
     AND a.incident_id = r.incident_id
    WHERE r.id = $1::uuid
      AND r.lease_token = $2::uuid
      AND r.status = 'processing'
      AND r.lease_expires_at > NOW()
      AND a.status = 'pending'
) AS can_send;

WITH finalized AS (
    UPDATE automation.approval_reminders
    SET status = 'delivered',
        delivered_at = NOW(),
        lease_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL,
        last_error = NULL
    WHERE id = $1::uuid
      AND lease_token = $2::uuid
      AND status = 'processing'
      AND lease_expires_at > NOW()
      AND NULLIF($3::text, '') IS NOT NULL
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM finalized) AS finalized;

WITH quarantined AS (
    UPDATE automation.approval_reminders
    SET status = 'delivery_unknown',
        last_error = LEFT($3::text, 1000),
        lease_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL
    WHERE id = $1::uuid
      AND lease_token = $2::uuid
      AND status = 'processing'
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM quarantined) AS quarantined;

WITH quarantined AS (
    UPDATE automation.approval_reminders
    SET status = 'delivery_unknown',
        last_error = 'Gmail delivery finalization unconfirmed',
        lease_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL
    WHERE id = $1::uuid
      AND lease_token = $2::uuid
      AND status = 'processing'
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM quarantined) AS quarantined;
